events.verdict: Williams (CHA) engages with Gasol (MEM) on his roll to the basket and the contact does not dislodge him or affect his ability to get post position.
Gasol (MEM) briefly grasps the arm of Williams (CHA) off ball in the post but the contact doesn't affect his ability to defend on the play.
Green (MEM) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Walker (CHA) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Batum (CHA) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Biyombo (CHA) cleanly blocks Green's (MEM) dunk attempt at the basket.
Batum (CHA) kicks the ball during the sideline inbound pass from Mack (MEM).
RLB shows Mack (MEM) makes contact to the arm of Biyombo (CHA) during his shooting motion that affects his play at the basket.
Gasol (MEM) makes brief contact with two extended arms to the chest of Biyombo (CHA) but the contact does not dislodge him.
Holiday (MEM) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Biyombo (CHA) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
LLB shows Monk (CHA) maintains a legal guarding position on Mack (MEM) at the end of the drive and makes clean ball contact on his swipe down.
LLB and RLB show Biyombo (CHA) maintains a legal guarding position during the driving shot attempt by Mack (MEM) and cleanly blocks the shot attempt.
[Observable in enhanced video] Mack (MEM) lifts his pivot foot.
Batum (CHA) and Mack (MEM) engage and separate during the screen.
[Observable in enhanced video] Gasol (MEM) lifts his foot during his spin move.
LLS shows Batum (CHA) maintains a legal guarding position during the jump shot attempt by Gasol (MEM).
Green (MEM) dislodges Williams (CHA) from his position during the rebound.
[Observable in enhanced video] Mack (MEM) lifts his foot during his spin move.
Williams (CHA) does not dislodge Green (MEM) during the rebound,
Williams (CHA) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Carter (MEM) and collapses his arms in to absorb the contact.
Biyombo (CHA) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Carter (MEM) and gives him room to avoid the contact and contest the shot.
Biyombo (CHA) places a hand/arm to the front of Gasol (MEM) at the start of the drive but the contact does not affect his SQBR.

Officials conference and deem that there is an inadvertent whistle and not an 8 second violation. Upon inbounding the ball, the Hornets must establish the ball in their own frontcourt within 0.7 seconds (the time at which the inadvertent whistle was blown).
Monk (CHA) receives the inbound pass and does not establish it in the frontcourt within 0.7 seconds and an 8 second violation should be called.
Gasol (MEM) delivers marginal contact to the chest of Biyombo (CHA) but does not extend his arm or dislodge him from his legally obtained position.
[Observable in enhanced video] Gasol (MEM) slides his pivot foot.
Holiday (MEM) commits a take foul on Walker (CHA).
Caboclo (MEM) commits a take foul on Monk (CHA).
[Observable in enhanced video] Carter (MEM) takes fewer than three steps after he has gathered the ball.
Caboclo (MEM) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Walker (CHA) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
